in_hebrew.name: Belden
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Belden הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Belden is derived from Old English 'bealden' meaning 'hill, mound, bold, or brave'. This name was given to a child who was thought to have the qualities of bravery and strength, much like a hill that stands tall and unyielding.
